## Matriz D

$$
D =
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & 0 & -1 \\
2 & 3 & 4 \\
-2 & 5 & 6
\end{array}
\right]
$$

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Cofactores

$$
|D| =
1
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
3 & 4 \\
5 & 6
\end{array}
\right]
-0
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
2 & 4 \\
-2 & 6
\end{array}
\right]
+(-1)
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
2 & 3 \\
-2 & 5
\end{array}
\right]
$$

$$
|D| =1(18-20)+0-1(10+6)
$$

$$
|D| =-2-16=\mathbf{-18}
$$

### Regla de Sarrus

$$
|D| =[(1 \cdot 3 \cdot 6)+(-2 \cdot 0 \cdot 4) + (2 \cdot 5 \cdot -1)]-[(-2 \cdot 3 \cdot -1)+ (2 \cdot 0 \cdot 6)+(5 \cdot 4 \cdot 1)]
$$

$$
|D|=[18-10]-[6+20]=8-26=\mathbf{-18}
$$
:::

## Matriz E

$$
E =
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
5 & 7 & 9 \\
1 & -4 & \frac{1}{2} \\
-3 & 2 & 0
\end{array}
\right]
$$

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Cofactores

$$
|E| =
5
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
-4 & \frac{1}{2} \\
2 & 0
\end{array}
\right]
-7
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & \frac{1}{2} \\
-3 & 0
\end{array}
\right]
+9
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & -4 \\
-3 & 2
\end{array}
\right]
$$

$$
|E| =5[(-4 \cdot 0)-(2\cdot \frac{1}{2})]-7[(1\cdot 0) -(-3\cdot \frac{1}{2})]+9[(1 \cdot 2)- (-3 \cdot -4)]
$$

$$
|E|=5[-1]-7[\frac{3}{2}]+9[-10]=-5 -\frac{21}{2}-90
$$

$$
|E| = \mathbf{-\frac{211}{2}}
$$

### Regla de Sarrus

$$
|E| =[(5 \cdot -4 \cdot 0)+(1 \cdot 2 \cdot 9) + (7 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot -3)]-[(-3 \cdot -4 \cdot 9)+ (2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot 5)+(1 \cdot 7 \cdot 0)]
$$

$$
|E|=[0+18-\frac{21}{2}]-[108+5+0]=\frac{15}{2}-\frac{226}{2}
$$

$$
|E| = \mathbf{-\frac{211}{2}}
$$
:::

## Matriz F

$$
F =
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & 2 & 3 \\
-3 & 1 & 0 \\
5 & -7 & 1
\end{array}
\right]
$$

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Cofactores

$$
|F| =
1
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
1 & 0 \\
-7 & 1
\end{array}
\right]
-2
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
-3 & 0 \\
5 & 1
\end{array}
\right]
+3
\left[
\begin{array}{ccc}
-3 & 1 \\
5 & -7
\end{array}
\right]
$$

$$
|F| =1[1-(-7 \cdot 0)]-2[-3-(5 \cdot 0)]+3[21-(5 \cdot 1)]
$$

$$
|F| =1+6+46 = \mathbf{55}
$$

### Regla de Sarrus

$$
|F| =[(1 \cdot 1 \cdot 1)+(-3 \cdot -7 \cdot 3) + (2 \cdot 0 \cdot 5)]-[(5 \cdot 1 \cdot 3)+ (-7 \cdot 0 \cdot 1)+(-3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1)]
$$

$$
|F|=[1+63+0]-[15+0-6]=64-9=\mathbf{55}
$$
:::
